ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% low-intensity (black) pixels in the central region versus 40% high-intensity (white/grey) pixels in the lateral lobe regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black region occupying the central 1/2 of the fluke area. Symmetrical high-intensity white fields on the outer lobes. Left lobe white field contains isolated black circular spots. Right lobe white field contains multiple intersecting dark linear streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with an approximate 145-degree obtuse angle; base of the notch is partially occluded by water splash.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire visible boundary, with pixel-amplitude variations of approximately 5-15 pixels. Extremities show high-relief irregular clusters (barnacle encrustations) breaking the linear flow.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave arc extending from the median notch upward and outward towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly textured, high-contrast clusters of white and brownish pixels located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization. Three distinct dark circular spots mapped on the left-center white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of at least four distinct, nearly parallel dark linear marks (rake marks) on the right lobe's white field, with one significant cross-cutting mark. One prominent curved dark line on the upper-left lobe white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the trailing edge of both tips; significant rake marks on the right ventral lobe surface.
